name: Process Map
description: Visual process flow with inputs and outputs per step
whenToUse: When an existing process needs documenting as a horizontal step chain with inputs, outputs, value-add classification and rework loops — not for a pure role or decision view, that is Deployment resp. Activity Flowchart.
insertHere: Insert here — or drop a card here to move it
importFromSipocHint: Pick a SIPOC. Every entry in its P column will be appended as a process step.
importFromSipocFailed: The SIPOC could not be read; nothing was imported.
loopTargetNotBefore: A loop can only return to an earlier step.

invariants.uniqueStepIds: Every step has its own id.
invariants.uniqueSubstepIds: Every sub-step of a step has its own id.
invariants.uniqueIoIds: Every input and every output of a step has its own id within its list.
invariants.uniqueLoopStepIds: Every rework step of a loop has its own id.
invariants.validExpanded: Only existing steps can be expanded.
invariants.loopTargetBefore: A loop only returns to a step that comes before its own step; otherwise it has no target.
